maddeler.e:
ينتجعوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَجِعُوا (yantajiʕū) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# يُنْتَجَعُوا (yuntajaʕū) /jun.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
